structured.approach: I followed the requirement-steps REQ-01 procedure for a ticket intake. I read the Zendesk ticket from the trigger record and the five contracted inputs (roadmap, regulatory sources, connector inventory, model dependency map, decision log). I also searched shared memory for related decisions and lessons. I wrote feat.intake with the verbatim ticket, its source link and seven change requests extracted from it. I wrote feat.prebacklog with these parts: a link to roadmap item R-AP-12, the affected repositories, a conflict check against D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050, the connector, regulatory and model-dependency checks, the lessons L-007 and L-011, stated assumptions, and non-blocking open questions. The Pre Backlog sheet and the DevOps board were not in the step's context, so the duplicate check is recorded as an open question for REQ-02 instead of being guessed. I did not call the GitHub API because the repository owner and board location are not in my inputs. Shell commands were denied by the G9 hook, so I used Read and Glob only.

claims.text: The intake is Zendesk ticket ZD-48600 (sample, synthetic), received 2026-10-24 through the Customer Feedback channel, with GitHub source hobasa-agentic-sdlc/requirements/ZD-48600.md.
The item links to roadmap item R-AP-12 (give AP managers earlier visibility of overdue payables) on the Q4 2026 AP roadmap, owned by the PM. R-AP-14 (aging export) is not linked.

The change affects four repositories: ap_pipeline (paid_date column and delays_by_vendor), ap_forecast (vendor_risk and the risk argument on build_explanation_request), ap_aging (overdue_with_risk) and ap_portal (renderOverdueRisk).

No conflict with a prior decision was found. overdue_with_risk returns only unpaid invoices, which is consistent with D-2026-050. Day counts must be calendar days after the due date (D-2026-031). Amounts must stay Decimal (D-2026-044).
No regulatory source applies to this change, so no section, page or rule impact is captured.
The connector inventory states that no source-system connector is affected by the ap_aging library. The vendor-feed connector for ap_pipeline is not covered, so this is raised as an open question.
The payment-delay explanation, which uses acme-llm model acme-text-2, is affected because its prompt gains ' Risk level: <risk>.' when risk is given. vendor_risk uses no LLM.
The thresholds that need explicit boundary tests are: more than 30 days past due, predicted delay > 30 for 'high', and > 10 for 'medium'.

open_questions: OQ-1: Which source-system connector supplies the ap_pipeline vendor feed, and does it already provide a paid date? org.connector_inventory covers only the ap_aging library.
OQ-2: The Pre Backlog sheet and the DevOps board were not in this step's context, so the duplicate check against them is open. REQ-02 should confirm there is no duplicate.
OQ-3: What should vendor_risk return for a vendor with an empty payment history?

OQ-4: Please confirm the assumptions: an invoice exactly 30 days past due is excluded; negative delay_days are kept; risk thresholds are strict (exactly 30 is 'medium', exactly 10 is 'low'); the id tie-break is ascending.
OQ-5: Which rounding rule applies to amounts shown to two decimals in the portal? Please also confirm that vendor names are HTML-escaped in renderOverdueRisk.
structured.summary: Ticket ZD-48600 is captured in feat.intake: the verbatim text, its source link and seven extracted change requests across ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal, plus the end-to-end proof. feat.prebacklog has a NEW draft entry linked to roadmap item R-AP-12 and trace ID FEAT-ZD-48600, waiting for PM review. The checks found no decision conflict and no regulatory impact. One LLM feature is affected: the payment-delay explanation prompt on acme-text-2. The vendor-feed connector is not covered by the inventory. The entry lists six assumptions and five non-blocking open questions. The duplicate check against the Pre Backlog sheet and DevOps board is deferred because neither was in context. The spine will send the notification after the PM gate.
